input.summary: Start Crypt Multiball, collect the left-ramp Jackpot and right-ramp Double Jackpot, add Frenzy, use captive-ball add-a-balls before the Double Jackpot, then spell CRYPT for five more add-a-balls and the Monster Jackpot.

steps.text: On the first launch, time the moving Guillotine light. Hit the lit drop target. Keep the initial ball save for the drop-bank return.
modeNotes: Skill Shot: The three Guillotine targets cycle. A lit hit scores 2,000,000 on ball 1 and one million more on each later ball.

steps.text: Use either spinner to light the Electric Chair. Press the door-handle launch button when the wanted Creature Feature flashes. Shoot the Electric Chair scoop.
modeNotes: Creature Feature: A spinner changes the selected mode unless the door handle locks it. Most modes can run together. Their timers continue during the Crypt Multiball opening animation.

steps.text: Hit the Tombstone to spell CRYPT. The C starts spotted. Before the first multiball, ball starts can also spot letters.
When CRYPT is complete, shoot the open Crypt with the upper-right flipper. On the first start, the center spinner can also start the multiball. Later starts require the Crypt.
modeNotes: Crypt Multiball: It starts with three balls. The left ramp scores a base 25,000,000 Jackpot. Left-spinner spins and Crypt shots raise it. The multiball ends when one ball remains.

steps.text: Before the Double Jackpot, hit the captive ball from control. Each registered hit adds a ball. This add-a-ball stops after the Double Jackpot.
Shoot the left ramp for the Jackpot. Then shoot the right ramp for the Double Jackpot.
modeNotes: Double Jackpot: Its base is twice the collected left-ramp Jackpot. Right-spinner spins and Crypt shots raise it before collection. A flashing right-ramp Frenzy can start on the same shot.

steps.text: After the Double Jackpot, hit the raised Tombstone five times to spell CRYPT. Wait for each added ball to enter play before you hit the next letter.
modeNotes: First CRYPT cycle after Double Jackpot: Each letter adds one ball. Completing CRYPT lights the Monster Jackpot. Later CRYPT cycles do not add balls.

steps.text: Shoot the open Crypt for the Monster Jackpot.
modeNotes: Monster Jackpot: It scores 50,000,000 plus the collected Double Jackpot, with a 100,000,000 minimum. Each later Monster Jackpot adds 50,000,000.

steps.text: During the multiball, shoot the right ramp once to light the next Frenzy and again to start it. Rip the spinners.
modeNotes: Frenzy: Living Dead scores 250,000 per switch, Chainsaw 500,000, Grave Digger 750,000, and Play the Organ 1,000,000. The value is stored in end-of-ball bonus. A tilt loses it.

steps.text: If the multiball ends before the left-ramp Jackpot, shoot the Crypt or center spinner within 12 seconds to restart it.

fallback.title: Creature Features and Frenzies
fallback.when: Use this plan when the Tombstone or Crypt shot is unreliable.

steps.text: Use a spinner to light the Electric Chair. Lock a feature that matches the safe shots. Shoot the scoop.
Use Frightmare when the right orbit is safe. Make 25 spinner turns in 25 seconds.
modeNotes: Frightmare: Spinner turns score during 25 seconds. A full right orbit can register both spinners. The 25th turn awards 25,000,000.

steps.text: Use Super Guillotine Targets when the center bank is safe. Hit the resetting drops during 25 seconds.
modeNotes: Super Guillotine Targets: Each target hit raises the value. The bank resets during the timed mode.

steps.text: Use Robbing the Crypt only when the upper-right flipper can loop the Crypt. Keep the four-second timer alive and finish CRYPT.
modeNotes: Robbing the Crypt: Each Crypt shot scores 10,000,000 and resets the timer. The final T scores 25,000,000 and ends the mode.

steps.text: Use Super Crypt Kicker before a long ball.
modeNotes: Super Crypt Kicker: The left kickback stays lit for the rest of the ball.

steps.text: Shoot the right ramp to light and start the highest available Frenzy. Rip spinners. Do not tilt away the stored bonus.

alternatives.title: Creature Feature completion route
alternatives.when: Use this route when the Electric Chair and spinners are reliable and Crypt Jam is reachable.

steps.text: In Thunder Storm, shoot either ramp during 20 seconds.
modeNotes: Thunder Storm: Ramp values grow from 1,000,000 to a 15,000,000 cap during the timer.

steps.text: In Skull Cracking, hit the captive ball during 20 seconds.
modeNotes: Skull Cracking: The first registered hit adds a ball. Up to five balls can be added. Later hits score more when more balls are in play.

steps.text: In Door Prize Select, use the flippers to select a door. Press the door handle to open it.
modeNotes: Door Prize Select: A points award continues the video mode. The hanging figure ends it.

steps.text: In Psycho Pops, make 25 pop hits in 25 seconds.
modeNotes: Psycho Pops: The 25th pop hit awards 25,000,000.

steps.text: In Lite Extra Ball, shoot the center spinner.
modeNotes: Lite Extra Ball: The center spinner collects the lit Extra Ball. Tournament settings can disable Extra Balls.

steps.text: In Werewolf Countdown, shoot the left spinner before the hurry-up reaches zero.
modeNotes: Werewolf Countdown: The award begins at 30,000,000 and counts down until the left spinner collects it.

steps.text: In Electric Chair, shoot the scoop while two or more balls remain.
modeNotes: Electric Chair: Six-ball play starts. Each scoop scores 1,000,000 times the balls in play. It ends when one ball remains.

steps.text: In Super Keeper Targets, hit the six KEEPER standups.
modeNotes: Super Keeper Targets: Target values rise. Completing all six scores 99,000,000.

alternatives.title: Frenzy stack
alternatives.when: Use this plan when the right ramp and spinners are the safest repeatable shots.

steps.text: Shoot the right ramp to light a Frenzy. Shoot it again to start.
Start a Creature Feature first when its spinner or ramp shots overlap.
Start Crypt Multiball while the Frenzy is ready, or start the Frenzy during the multiball.
Shoot spinners. More active balls make more switch hits.
Preserve the ball to receive the stored Fast Goring Frenzy bonus. Bonus X does not multiply it.
modeNotes: A tilt removes the stored Fast Goring Frenzy bonus.

steps.text: Start all 12 Creature Features. You do not have to complete them.
Shoot the Electric Chair when Crypt Jam is ready.
Keep at least two balls in play. Every switch scores 1,000,000.
modeNotes: Crypt Jam: It starts six-ball play with a 25-second ball save. It ends when one ball remains.

playfieldReferences.context: Before the Double Jackpot, hit the captive ball from control.
playfieldReferences.label: Captive ball
playfieldReferences.description: The captive ball is beside the KEE targets on the left-middle playfield.

playfieldReferences.context: Shoot the left ramp for the Jackpot.
playfieldReferences.label: Left ramp Jackpot
playfieldReferences.description: The left ramp is in the upper-left area.

playfieldReferences.label: Electric Chair scoop
playfieldReferences.description: The Electric Chair scoop is in the upper-center-left area.

playfieldReferences.context: Hit the Tombstone to spell CRYPT.
playfieldReferences.label: Tombstone and Crypt
playfieldReferences.description: The Tombstone blocks the Crypt in the upper-center area.

playfieldReferences.context: On the first start, the center spinner can also start the multiball.
playfieldReferences.label: Center spinner
playfieldReferences.description: The center spinner is in the upper-center-right lane.

playfieldReferences.context: Then shoot the right ramp for the Double Jackpot.
playfieldReferences.label: Right ramp Double Jackpot and Frenzy
playfieldReferences.description: The right ramp is on the upper-right side.

checkBeforePlay: Older 2.x ROMs and newer 3.x ROMs use different scoring values; confirm the installed ROM before relying on exact values.
Tournament settings can disable Extra Balls.

techniques.name: Upper-flipper Electric Chair shot
techniques.instruction: Use the upper-right flipper. The scoop is open toward that flipper and is easier there than from the lower flippers.

techniques.name: Upper-flipper Tombstone and Crypt shot
techniques.instruction: Use the upper-right flipper for the Tombstone and open Crypt. The Electric Chair blocks part of the lower-flipper line.

techniques.name: Safe auto-launch return
techniques.instruction: If launch drains through the Guillotine bank, hold the upper-right flipper on a relaunch. The ball can deflect to the lower-right flipper.

techniques.name: Right-ramp trick shot
techniques.instruction: A partial right-ramp shot can land on its return wireform and register as a completed ramp plus 5,000,000. Do not force it on a copy that rejects toward the center.

cautions.issue: Tombstone hits can fail to register.
cautions.response: Use a direct upper-flipper shot. Stop repeated attempts when clean hits do not advance CRYPT. Use Creature Features and Frenzies instead.

cautions.issue: The captive ball can need a hard hit.
cautions.response: Test it during ball save or early multiball. Do not depend on its add-a-ball when hard shots do not register.

cautions.issue: The left kickback may not reach the intended upper spinner.
cautions.response: Watch the first kickback. Hold the upper-right flipper or prepare the lower flippers for the actual feed.

cautions.issue: Mode timers continue during the multiball opening animation.
cautions.response: Do not start a short mode immediately before Crypt Multiball unless the overlapping shots justify the lost time.

cautions.issue: Frenzy points are paid in end-of-ball bonus.
cautions.response: Do not make a large recovery move after the ball is lost. A tilt removes the stored value.

input.simpleOverview: Spelling C-R-Y-P-T opens the Crypt for three-ball Multiball in Tales from the Crypt. Shoot the left ramp for Jackpot, use the captive ball for add-a-balls before collecting the right-ramp Double Jackpot, then spell C-R-Y-P-T again on the raised Tombstone and return to the Crypt for Monster Jackpot.
input.overview: In Tales from the Crypt, spelling C-R-Y-P-T opens the Crypt for three-ball Multiball. Shoot the left ramp for Jackpot, use the captive ball for add-a-balls before collecting the right-ramp Double Jackpot, then spell C-R-Y-P-T again on the raised Tombstone. Shoot the open Crypt for Monster Jackpot and use the right ramp to add a lit Frenzy.
machineSetup: Older 2.x ROMs and newer 3.x ROMs use different scoring values; confirm the installed ROM before relying on exact values.
